title: oenothera filiformis
intro: Oenothera filiformis, commonly known as Pink Evening Primrose, is a flowering plant species within the evening primrose family (Onagraceae). The plant has been traditionally used to treat various health issues, including anxiety, insomnia, and skin conditions, due to its potential health benefits. The therapeutic actions of Oenothera filiformis include sedative, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant properties, which may contribute to its potential in alleviating symptoms of anxiety and other conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and fatty acids, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions and potential health benefits.
